candidates.pitch: Gladiator ladder: five rival types, each with a signature weapon and tell; light, heavy, block, roll to freedom.
Every clean hit steals the rival's weapon; parries steal it back. Hold the golden gladius when the horn sounds.
Each round, your earlier bouts replay as bronze ghosts fighting beside the rival; beat your own habits.
Iron-ball duel: catch the rival's throw on timing, hurl it back faster until someone can't catch.
Two gladiators chained ankle to ankle: every blow yanks the chain, and footwork is a tug-of-war.

concept.why: Bends what a hit does: a hit transfers the weapon, so the fight is possession, not health. Left the standard's column-destruction and crowd-weapon families: weapons come from the rival's hands, not the crowd. Obvious ladder was already drafted.
concept.hook: every clean hit rips the weapon from your rival's hands

references.borrow: a three-way directional guard; a matched-direction parry, read from the attacker's weapon angle, opens a punish.
disarm by matching sword height then thrusting; the disarmed fighter rolls and dives to recover the blade.
three steals in a row set the holder on fire, visible to all, until the rival steals back.

pillars.line: A hit moves the sword, not a health bar
pillars.rules_out: Health bars, damage numbers and fights decided by attrition
Safe best moves, unpunishable heavies, a guard that blocks everything

pillars.line: Skill is in the feet and facing
pillars.rules_out: Auto-face, attack arcs over 60 degrees, speed-stat difficulty

verbs.cancel: Roll from recovery frame 6; a landed hit cancels into strike_heavy

verbs.cancel: Wind-up cancels into guard before frame 6 (a feint); nothing once active

context: Possession flips: the holder walks and defends, the unarmed runs and hunts
Burning Blade ignites after three hits in a row, visible to both
Oiled Finale at 15 s left turns the centre into skating

skill.floor: Press J to jab the holder and take the gladius
ceiling: Parry-steal: tap guard in the 8 f before the holder's cut lands
Roll-cancel rip: roll behind a whiffed cleave and rip the unguarded back
Oil slide-rip: roll across the oiled disc into a rip before the horn

feel.knockback: Impulse 3 + 0.4 x hits taken this round, cleave x2.5, via TLBiped.shove so Ursa slides less
feel.reaction: Jab TLHit.react 0.3 flinch; steal 0.7 stumble from the blow; cleave 1.2 then TLHit.down 40 f
feel.whiff: Full recovery, a sand-scuff sound via TLAudio.play, no burst, sword arm left open
feel.shake: None on jabs; 0.08 m over 10 f on a steal; 0.25 m over 18 f on knock-down
feel.camera: Orbit at 42 degrees on the fighters' midpoint, frame 0.26, near wall 0.8 m, red edge arrow off-screen

clips.moment: The holder's cut is parried, gold sparks freeze both 10 f, the sword flips hands
A burning-blade cleave floors Ursa: shake, smoke, crowd roar
On the oil, a sliding rip steals the sword as the horn sounds

design.first_minute: Opens face to face with Pulex holding the gold; hint 'J: jab him to steal it'. He only jabs, with slow 24 f tells
design.fail_state: Horn screen names who held the gold and the deciding move; loser kneels, crowd cheers; J rematches at once
out_of_scope: More than one gladius in play
More than two fighters or online play

design_reviewed.notes: No slop; this goes to the builders. Fix three contradictions while building. Calyx's feint cancels at frame 14, but the heavy wind-up is 10 f and feints must cancel before frame 6, so give rival feints their own 22 f tell and cancel window. Align the parry facing (45 degrees) with the guard arc (60). Name the clip for a steal stumble and for Ursa's charge, so the parry_steal moment is not a placeholder.

brief.pitch: One golden sword: hit clean to steal it, parry to snatch it back, hold it at the horn.

aspects.title: The Golden Gladius
aspects.line: Only one sword. Hit clean and it jumps to your hand.
aspects.detail: One gladius prop on the holder's hand. Unarmed strike or rip landing unguarded transfers it; parrying the holder's swing transfers it. Holder walks only (no run), so must fight. Holder at the horn wins the round. Transfer: 6 f hit-stop both, TLHit.react 0.7, gold sparks.

alternatives.title: Knocked Loose
alternatives.line: Hits knock the sword flying; dive and roll to grab it.

alternatives.title: Two Blades, One Gold
alternatives.line: Both armed; only the gold blade counts at the horn.

alternatives.title: Glory Clock
alternatives.line: Every second holding scores; most glory wins, not the horn.

aspects.title: Guard, Rip, Jab
aspects.line: Guard stops jabs, rips break guards, jabs stop rips.
aspects.detail: Light strike 4/3/14 f interrupts a wind-up. Heavy 10/4/28: unarmed it is a rip that beats guard; armed a cleave that floors for 40 f via TLHit.down. Guard (block clip) stops lights; its first 8 f are a parry facing within 45 degrees. Roll: 20 i-frames.

alternatives.title: Three-Way Guard
alternatives.line: Pick left, right or high guard to match the swing.

alternatives.title: Grab and Throw
alternatives.line: No swords swung: grab, throw, and wrestle the gold away.

aspects.title: Three Rival Gladiators
aspects.line: A tiny roller, a charging bear, a champion who fakes.
aspects.detail: Pulex (0.85 body_scale, bare head) jabs and rolls behind your heavy; tell 24 f arm-back. Ursa (1.3 scale, bronze helm) body_check charge, 30 f stamp tell. Calyx (crested helm) feints heavies after you parry twice. Each taunts on a steal, kneels via TLHit.down when beaten.

alternatives.title: Your Own Ghost
alternatives.line: The rival copies how you fought last round.

alternatives.title: Two on One
alternatives.line: Two weak rivals pass the stolen sword between them.

aspects.title: High Ring Camera
aspects.line: See both fighters from above the low arena wall.
aspects.detail: ctx.cameras.orbit on a pivot kept at the fighters' midpoint, pitch 42 degrees, fov 50, distance 9-16 m widening with their gap; ctx.cameras.frame(pivot, 0.26). Near wall is 0.8 m stone; stands only on the far side. Off-screen rival gets a red TLHud edge arrow.

alternatives.title: Over the Shoulder
alternatives.line: Camera behind your gladiator, rival charging at the lens.

alternatives.title: Side-On Duel
alternatives.line: Flat side view like a stage, fighters left and right.

aspects.title: Burning Blade
aspects.line: Land three hits in a row and the sword catches fire.
aspects.detail: Holder landing 3 hits without losing the gladius ignites it: TLVfx.attach nitro_flame on the blade, a cheer. Burning, the holder may run and a light strike stumbles at 0.9. One steal douses it with smoke. Seen by both, so the rival must gamble on a rip.

alternatives.title: Crowd Favour
alternatives.line: Taunts fill a meter; the crowd throws you a shield.

alternatives.title: Closing Gates
alternatives.line: Every steal, the arena wall steps one metre inward.

aspects.title: The Oiled Finale
aspects.line: Last fifteen seconds, the sand turns to slippery oil!
aspects.detail: At 15 s left the horn blares and a 14 m centre disc switches to an ice-tagged patch: TLBiped skate locomotion, knockback slides 3x farther, rolls glide. Fighters steer by momentum; a rip becomes a slide-tackle. Drop it and the finale is just a countdown.

alternatives.title: Emperor's Whim
alternatives.line: At the final horn the Emperor swaps who holds it.

alternatives.title: Rain of Fruit
alternatives.line: The crowd pelts the holder; every hit makes them flinch.

brief.rules: Duel for one golden gladius. Round 45 s; whoever holds it when the horn sounds wins; best of three per rival. Holder walks only and defends; unarmed runs and hunts. Verbs at 60 Hz: strike (J) 4/3/14 f, armed a cut (react 0.3 flinch, shove back), unarmed a jab that steals if it lands unguarded or from side/back; strike_heavy (K) 10/4/28 f, armed a cleave (react 1.2, TLHit.down 40 f, blockable, parryable), unarmed a rip that beats guard and steals; guard (hold L, block clip) stops lights from the front 60 degrees, first 8 f are a parry: parrying the holder steals, the holder parrying a rip stumbles the rival 0.7 for a punish; roll (Space) 20 i-frames, 12 f recovery; taunt (T, holder only) 50 f fully punishable, next hit counts double toward Burning Blade. Three hits in a row ignite the blade (holder may run, jabs stumble 0.9) until a steal. Feel: hit-stop 4 f jab, 6 f steal, 10 f parry, 12 f cleave on both fighters, decaying visual vibration; knockback impulse 3 + 0.4 x hits taken, cleave x2.5, through TLBiped.shove; whiffs play full recovery, a scuff sound, no burst; shake only on steals (0.08/10 f) and knock-downs (0.25/18 f). Intensity: calm open, steals speed up, Oiled Finale at 15 s, horn countdown beeps in last 5 s. End screen names who held the gold and the deciding move; J rematches, a win climbs to the next rival.
brief.arena: Round sand floor 22 m across, a ground_patch inside a ring of stones. Far side (-Z): raked kit stands with crowd, an entrance portal and two flags. Near side (+Z, camera side): a stones row only 0.8 m high, so the lens never sits behind scenery. A 14 m centre disc turns into an ice-tagged patch at 15 s left (Oiled Finale). Camera: ctx.cameras.orbit on a pivot the pack keeps at the fighters' midpoint, pitch 42 degrees, fov 50, distance 9-16 m widening with their gap, framed at 0.26; default yaw looks from +Z toward the stands; right-drag turns it; a red edge arrow on the TLHud marks an off-screen rival.
brief.ai: Rivals steer with TLSteer.arrive, TLSteer.separate (radius 1.4 m) and flee, colliding capsules scaled by body_scale. Pulex the Flea: 0.85 scale, bare head, red loincloth; jabs and rolls behind any whiffed heavy; tell 24 f arm pulled back; on a steal he hops in a taunt, beaten he kneels (TLHit.down). Ursa the Bear: 1.3 scale, bronze full helm, mass shoves him less; charges with body_check after a 30 f stamp tell, a landed charge steals; beaten he falls and sits. Calyx the Champion: player height, crested helm and banner prop; mixes cuts and rips, after two player parries he feints a heavy (cancels at frame 14) then jabs; tell 22 f. Harder means more aggression, reading the player's last answer, feints and cornering at the wall, never speed or damage.
brief.controls: move (WASD, camera-relative, facing follows movement); strike (J, light cut or jab); heavy (K, cleave or rip); guard (hold L, tap timed is a parry); roll (Space, along move direction); taunt (T, holder only). Right-drag and wheel turn and zoom the camera.
brief.mood: Sun-baked toon colosseum in the global inked look: ochre sand, white stone, a roaring crowd, the gladius glinting gold. Sounds: horn blasts, metallic clangs on parries, crowd cheers swelling as the sword changes hands.
